integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a close-up in a warm, softly lit artisan bakery kitchen shows a small glass bowl holding a glossy, golden egg-and-milk wash on a wooden prep counter. A female pastry chef with rolled-up sleeves and an apron lifts a soft pastry brush and gently dips it into the shimmering liquid; the bristles glisten as she lifts them, a thin amber stream falling back into the bowl. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up on the shaped bread dough pieces: with light, careful strokes she brushes a thin, even layer of the glaze across the surface of each dough piece, each stroke leaving a wet, luminous sheen that catches the warm light, hinting at the beautiful caramel color it will develop in the oven. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot as she turns gracefully, carrying a baking tray neatly lined with the glazed dough pieces, moving steadily toward the oven with calm, practiced movements. [Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the oven: she slides the tray smoothly into the baking appliance, then closes the oven door in one fluid, seamless motion, and her hand rests briefly on the closed door as soft oven light glows through the window while the camera holds nearly static with a gentle push-in.

overall_soundscape: Soft kitchen ambience with the gentle drip of egg wash into the glass bowl and the faint whisper of brush strokes over dough. The tray slides with a light metallic scrape into the oven, followed by the muffled, solid click of the oven door closing.

non_diegetic_music: Warm, gentle acoustic guitar at a slow, steady tempo with soft sustained strings underneath, fading out as the oven door closes.
